title: Stolen Lands NPC Role
note: generate:character (mode conjunction). On any NEW CHARACTER result the engine rolls this AND the AC Character Crafter; flesh the NPC from setting-canon factions + the current zone/scene. Stat on the fly via the NPC Statistics oracle in PF2e units, scaled by the Diminisher.

entries.value: Bandit / outlaw — preys on the routes; flees, regroups, informs to survive
Frontier settler / homesteader — hard-pressed, wants safety and a fair charter
Hunter / trapper / ranger — knows the wilds, the lairs, and the rumors
Merchant / trader / caravaneer — profit, protection, and trade routes
Soldier / mercenary / sellsword — coin and a cause; loyalty for sale
Brevic noble / official / envoy — status, House interest, court calculation
Aldori swordlord / duelist — honor, the blade, Rostland's pride
Priest / cultist / zealot — a god's work (Erastil, Gorum, Lamashtu, the Bloom)
Fey / First World being — alien logic; keeps bargains to the letter
Nomen centaur / wilderness tribesperson — proud; respect earns alliance
Tiger Lord barbarian — strength, raid, and Gorum's favor
Pitaxian agent / spy / propagandist — Irovetti's deniable hand
Scholar / sage / cartographer — lore, maps, the land's buried history
Monster-kin leader (kobold / lizardfolk / boggard / troll-kin) — a rival little realm
